annotations.title: utilpeek: extract emails, URLs, IPs, dates and more from text

description: utilpeek: Extract emails, URLs, domains, IPs, dates and crypto addresses from text. To mask personal data use redact_pii; for names and places use extract_entities. Returns the emails, URLs, domains (ICANN suffixes), IPv4 / IPv6, phone-like numbers, hashtags, mentions, EVM and BTC addresses (Base58Check / Bech32 checksums verified) and dates (normalised to ISO) found in the text, deduplicated and counted in first-seen order; patterns run on RE2 and each hit is re-checked. Phone hits are phone-like digit groups, not validated numbers (see /v1/phone). Typically under 0.7 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored.

max_per_type.description: Most distinct items returned per type (1-1000, default 100); `truncated` says when more were found.
